scenes.label: Opening Hook
scenes.audio: Have you ever had this feeling? The more you work, the more tired you get, yet you still seem to not keep up with the rhythm of the times.

scenes.label: Product Information
scenes.audio: Hi everyone, I am Li Taixin. I was once a top 100 sales consultant for Porsche globally. The purpose is to help all sales consultants live more easily.

scenes.label: Problem Solving
scenes.audio: Imagine your wisdom is like a well. At first, the water is full, but by constantly drawing water without pouring water in, this well will eventually dry up. If we continue to replenish it, that well can permanently provide a steady stream of living water of knowledge.

scenes.label: Product Selling Points
scenes.audio: Research shows that for those who spend an average of more than 30 minutes a day on learning, reading, or online courses, their work performance after one year is more than 20% higher than those who don't learn at all.

scenes.label: Product Selling Points
scenes.audio: Whitehead once said, 'Only when humans invented the method of invention, will society develop rapidly.' In other words, knowing how to engage in lifelong learning can continuously help you upgrade yourself.

scenes.label: Call to Action
scenes.audio: Don't let yourself stay in place. Starting today, give yourself a small goal of daily learning. If you want to know more about how to improve yourself and strengthen sales, hurry and join our ranks to progress together. Bye-bye.
